---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for BRIGx
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A brief, one-sentence description of the feature you are requesting.

## Motivation / use case

Describe the problem you are trying to solve or the workflow you want to support. Why is this useful for comparative genomics / bioinformatics? (e.g. "When comparing more than 10 genomes, it becomes difficult to distinguish rings — a legend with configurable colours would help.")

## Proposed solution

Describe the solution you would like to see. Be as specific or as high-level as you like — concrete UI mockups, algorithm suggestions, or just a description of the desired behaviour are all welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Have you found any workarounds or alternative tools that partially address this? Knowing what you have already tried helps prioritise.

## Additional context

Add any other context, screenshots, references to similar features in BRIG or other tools, or relevant publications here.
